name: @w1zdun/pi-sampling
description: Per-model sampling params (temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, repetition_penalty) for pi's openai-completions custom providers. Reads `sampling` blocks from ~/.pi/agent/models.json. (chat_template_kwargs is now handled natively by pi.)
author: w1zdun

scripts.release: npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
